Valkyrie v0.6.26 sky / room lighting (HDRI). All CC0 from Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), no attribution
required, credited anyway. Each was shrunk to 256x128, very bright sun spots capped and the overall
brightness normalised so it works as soft image-based light + reflections (~130 KB each).

              (Black File facility)
